raws.prompt: Game sprite. A single small moon seen from space as a perfect round sphere, centred, filling about 82% of a square image, completely inside the frame with empty margin all around. Style: soft watercolour and ink-wash illustration, translucent layered washes with gentle pigment granulation and soft wet blooms, calm slightly desaturated colours, delicate hand-painted surface detail, a crisp clean round outer edge. Isolated on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, no stars, no rings, no moons, no text, no border, no drop shadow.

debris.prompt: Game sprite sheet.
